summary: Grayscale XRP Trust ETF filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing amendments to Authorized Participant Agreements and related operational changes. The trust, sponsored by Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, entered amended participant agreements with Macquarie Capital (USA) Inc. and Virtu Americas LLC, permitting in-kind creations and redemptions alongside the existing cash process. The sponsor also supplemented offering disclosures to reflect in-kind mechanics and amended its custody agreement to add Anchorage Digital Bank as an additional custodian. The filing includes Exhibit 10.1 and a supplemental description of creation/redemption procedures. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is present; the event is a routine operational and custody update.
